instr.NO: Normally open contact: conducts when the bit is 1
instr.NC: Normally closed contact: conducts when the bit is 0
instr.POS: Rising edge: conducts for one scan when the bit goes from 0 to 1
instr.NEG: Falling edge: conducts for one scan when the bit goes from 1 to 0
instr.COIL: Coil: writes the rung state into the bit
instr.NCOIL: Negated coil: writes the inverse of the rung state into the bit
instr.SET: Sets and holds (latch) the bit while the rung is energized
instr.RESET: Resets (unlatch) the bit while the rung is energized
instr.TON: On-delay: Q/DN turns on after the time with the input on
instr.TOF: Off-delay: Q/DN turns off after the time with the input off
instr.TP: Pulse: generates a fixed-length pulse on the rising edge
instr.RTO: Retentive timer: accumulates time, cleared only by RES
instr.CTU: Up counter: adds 1 on each rising edge; DN when ACC ≥ PRE
instr.CTD: Down counter: subtracts 1 on each rising edge; output when ACC ≤ 0
instr.CTUD: Up/down counter; the 3rd operand is the count-down bit
instr.SR: SR bistable (set dominant): the rung sets Q; bit R resets it, but S wins when both are active
instr.RS: RS bistable (reset dominant): the rung sets Q; bit R1 resets it and wins when both are active
instr.JMP: Jump: with the rung energized, jumps to the rung with the given label (LBL); skipped rungs do not run
instr.LBL: Label: target of a jump (JMP). Must be the first element of the rung
instr.CALL: Calls a subroutine (another program) with the rung energized; it runs entirely and returns
instr.SCALE: Linear scaling: converts IN from the input range [min, max] to the output range (e.g. 0–27648 → 0–100%)
instr.PID: Simplified PID controller (output 0–100%). Without rung power it is in manual: the output is not written. Ti and Td in seconds (Ti = 0 disables the integral)
instr.BSL: Bit shift left: on each rising edge of the rung, shifts the word 1 bit and puts the input bit into bit 0 (part tracking)
instr.BSR: Bit shift right: on each rising edge, shifts 1 bit to the right and puts the input bit into the highest bit
instr.SHL: Shifts the word N bits to the left while the rung is energized
instr.SHR: Shifts the word N bits to the right (logical) while the rung is energized
instr.NORM_X: Normalizes VALUE from [MIN, MAX] to 0.0–1.0 (S7-1200 style)
instr.SCALE_X: Scales VALUE (0.0–1.0) to the range [MIN, MAX] (S7-1200 style)

motor.title: Direct-on-line motor start
motor.summary: Seal-in, NC stop button and thermal overload relay.
motor.task: Pressing B_START must turn the K_MOTOR contactor on and keep it on. B_STOP (NC) or a trip of the F_OVL thermal relay (NC) must stop the motor. Light H_RUN while the motor runs and H_FAULT when the overload trips.

starDelta.title: Star-delta starter
starDelta.task: When starting, energize K1 (main) and K2 (star). After 5 s, turn K2 off and K3 (delta) on. K2 and K3 must NEVER be on together (short circuit). B_STOP and F_OVL turn everything off.
starDelta.shortCircuit: K2 and K3 were on together: short circuit!

traffic.title: Traffic light with pedestrian crossing
traffic.task: Run the green → yellow → red cycle for vehicles. The pedestrian green may only light with the vehicle red. Challenge: use B_PED to bring the crossing forward.
traffic.multiple: More than one vehicle light on

conveyor.title: Box sorting conveyor
conveyor.summary: Sensors, memory, edges, timer and counter.
conveyor.task: Turn the conveyor (M_BELT) on/off with B_START/B_STOP. Tall boxes are detected by S_HIGH and must be pushed off by the Y_PUSH cylinder when they reach S_PUSH. Short boxes go to the end.

tank.title: Tank level control
tank.summary: Level switches, analog signal and scaling.
tank.task: Keep the level between the LSL and LSH switches by turning the P_FILL pump on and off. Convert LT_LEVEL (0–27648) to % in LEVEL_PCT and turn H_ALARM on above 95%.

tankPid.title: Level control with PID
tankPid.summary: Analog scaling, proportional valve and PID controller.
tankPid.task: Convert LT_LEVEL (0–27648) to % in LEVEL_PCT, use a PID to hold the level at the SP_PCT setpoint by opening the proportional valve CV_VALVE (0–27648), and honor the PID_ON switch (manual/automatic). Test setpoint and consumption changes.

cylinders.title: Pneumatic cylinders A+ B+ A− B−
cylinders.summary: Electro-pneumatic sequence with limit switches (step method or GRAFCET).
cylinders.task: On each press of B_START (with both cylinders retracted: A0 and B0), run the A+ B+ A− B− sequence once: extend A (Y_A) to A1, extend B (Y_B) to B1, retract A to A0 and retract B to B0. The valves are 5/2 single-solenoid with spring return: the output must stay on while the cylinder must remain extended. Pressing B_START in the middle of the cycle must not disturb it.
cylinders.lastWrong: The last cycle did not follow the A+ B+ A− B− order.

faults.help: Faults live in sensors, wiring and contactors, never in the program. An input fault changes what the PLC reads; an output fault changes what the field does, even with the PLC output correct. That is how troubleshooting is practiced.
faults.noCandidates: This project has no tags bound to physical inputs or outputs. Bind tags to hardware or use a virtual plant.
faults.challengeHelp: A random, hidden fault is injected on a signal used by the program. Operate the plant and use Watch, the Trend chart and 🔎 "Why?" to find it.
faults.challengeNone: No digital field signal is used by the program: there is nowhere to hide a fault.
faults.challengeActive: There is a hidden fault in the field. Which signal is faulty and what is the fault?
faults.correct: Correct! Fault found in {{attempts}} attempt(s). The fault was repaired.
faults.revealed: The fault was: {{signal}} — {{kind}}. It has been removed.
faults.wrongKind: Right signal, but the fault is a different one

analog.frozen: Transmitter frozen at the current value

digital.stuckOn: Welded contact (always on in the field)
digital.stuckOff: Burnt output / open coil (never turns on in the field)

hmi.title: HMI screens
hmi.empty: No screens yet. Build operator screens (800 × 480, like a 7" HMI) with buttons, lamps, displays, bars, numeric inputs, navigation and charts bound to tags.
hmi.help: Click a palette item to add it. Drag to move, use the bottom-right corner to resize and Del to delete the selected item.

modbus.title: Modbus TCP bridge (real HMI / SCADA)
modbus.help: Connect a real HMI or SCADA to the simulation. Run the bridge on this machine (Node 24+) from the project folder, enter the port and the pairing code it shows and click Connect. The HMI connects to the bridge's Modbus TCP (port 5020 by default).
modbus.security: The bridge only accepts this page (localhost or the origin given with --origin) with the pairing code and, by default, only serves Modbus on localhost. Use --lan only on lab networks: Modbus has no authentication.
modbus.tooManyAttempts: Too many wrong codes: the bridge locked pairing for a moment. Wait and check the code in the terminal.
modbus.unreachable: Bridge not found on this port, or it refused this page. Is it running on this machine, with the command above?
modbus.auto: automatic (bits as coils, numbers as holding registers)
